description: This file defines the EmailsSignatureResolver class used for managing email signature resolution in SuiteCRM, including handling HTML and plain text signatures, error management, and logging.

classes.name: EmailsSignatureResolver
classes.description: Handles email signature resolution, including validation, error tracking, and retrieval of HTML and plain text signatures within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: setSignatureArray
methods.description: Sets the signature array and resolves HTML and plain text signatures, returning any errors.

methods.name: resolveHtml
methods.description: Determines the HTML signature; handles ambiguity and missing signature errors.

methods.name: resolvePlaintext
methods.description: Determines the plain text signature; handles ambiguity and missing signature errors.

methods.name: getPlaintext
methods.description: Returns the resolved plain text signature.

methods.name: isNoDefaultAvailable
methods.description: Checks if no default signature is available.
